actual_allocation.important_distinction: Authoring selection is least-recent/quota based and reserves a 10% public-evaluation focus; dataset mix_weight is a separate downstream sampling control. All three sampled catalog weights are 1.0.

allocation.30_percent: under-evidenced missing-prototype tasks needing a bounded teaching/four-query probe

alternative_allocation.bounded_test: Randomize 12 eligible missing-prototype tasks into current least-recent selection versus the stratified arm (6 each). Cap authoring at one normal review session per task; retain exact-Racket label count, accepted four-query episodes, rival-refuting demo sets, visible-input uniqueness, and reviewer minutes. No model training job.

estimated_label_budget.basis: Estimates only; actual identifiability can require more demonstrations.
estimated_label_budget.four_demo_task_like_1314f4ccf5cc: 16 exact Racket labels = 2 settings × (4 demonstrations + 4 queries)
estimated_label_budget.pilot: 6 tasks per arm, two settings each: approximately 72-96 labels per arm, before retries
estimated_label_budget.standard_two_setting_task: 12 exact Racket labels = 2 settings × (2 demonstrations + 4 queries)

alternative_allocation.name: readiness-and-cost stratified pilot inside the existing unfinished-original bucket
alternative_allocation.stopping_rule: Do not adopt the stratification unless it improves accepted four-query episodes per reviewer hour by at least 15% after all 12 tasks, while ambiguity/rejection rate is no more than 5 percentage points worse and no source stratum loses coverage. Stop early after 6 tasks if the upper-bound gain cannot reach 15% or a safety issue appears.

Retained reviewer claims are source-bound observations, not independently re-benchmarked here.

catalog.summary: Read arbitrary 2x2 tiles in row-major order, from the innermost ring outward. Each tile's four pixels independently color the corresponding ring quadrants. Output side is h*w/2, at most 30. Zero is an ordinary color. A three-draw curriculum interleaves canonical profiles, repeated/uniform-tile counterexamples at noncanonical shapes, and broader inputs.

sample_method: Always include the pinned task; rank all other current main_ids by SHA256(seed_bytes || task_id), then take the first two.
